investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser/JS execution) against the venue's own official '/fr/agenda' page. No JSON-LD/ICS/JSON API is present — every upcoming show is server-rendered directly as static HTML: one full-date heading per calendar date ('Lun. 7 sept. 2026'), followed by one-or-more artist cards (time/title/permalink) until the next date heading.

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of https://www.lebaisersale.com/fr/agenda immediately exposed 27 real, dated, statically-rendered show cards spanning 2026-08-27 to 2026-09-17 (19 distinct dates, some with more than one show), plus real server-rendered pagination links (/fr/agenda/page-2 .. page-9) for further weeks. No JSON-LD, ICS, or JSON API is present anywhere on this page; no escalation beyond Level 1 was needed since the static HTML itself already fully answers the investigation.

venue_reference: Le Baiser Salé, 58 rue des Lombards, 75001 Paris

identity.notes: The retained page's own <title> reads "L'agenda des concerts - Le Baiser Salé" at the venue's own domain lebaisersale.com. Every sampled show's own permalink resolves under this same domain ('/fr/agenda/{id}-{slug}'). The given street address (58 rue des Lombards, 75001 Paris) is independently corroborated by a live Nominatim geocoding match naming this exact venue at this exact address (see ev-nominatim-le-baiser-sale) — the page itself does not restate its own street address.

site_classification.platform: Custom CMS (no WordPress/Drupal/wp-json signal detected). The '/fr/agenda' page server-renders every upcoming show directly as static HTML — no JSON-LD, ICS, or JSON API found anywhere on the page.

title.notes: Each card's own <h2 class="artist-name"> text, stated directly.

start_date.notes: No card itself restates any date at all. Each card is retained as the next 'agenda-line' sibling immediately following one 'date-timeline' heading (which itself states the FULL date, e.g. 'Lun. 7 sept. 2026', directly) and before the next such heading — a source-authored structural convention (proven by direct positional containment in the retained fixture, not assumed from visual layout), mechanically reproduced offline in evidence/offline-proof-output.txt.

derivation.rule: The nearest preceding 'date-timeline' heading governs every 'artist-wrapper' card that follows it, until the next such heading. Parse the heading's own French 'Day. D month[.] YYYY' text into a calendar date and assign it, unchanged, to every governed card.
inputs: card is the next artist-wrapper sibling following that heading, before the next date-timeline heading

time.value: 21:00 (floating local — no explicit UTC offset or timezone stated anywhere on the page)
time.notes: Each card's own clock-icon time text, stated directly.

end.notes: No end time or end date appears anywhere on this page for any sampled show.

venue_location.notes: Not stated per-card or page-wide as a discrete, structurally-provable field. This source represents exactly one physical venue, consistent with this project's existing single-venue-per-source precedent (badehaus-berlin-01) — venue identity is intended to resolve via source_id at activation time, not by parsing a field the source does not actually expose.

source_record_id.notes: This source's own numeric-id-prefixed permalink slug ('/fr/agenda/{id}-{slug}') is stable and site-authored, but at least one real, retained sampled recurring series (e.g. "#LaPetiteHeure by... Etienne Mbappé", slug '5869-lapetiteheure-by...-etienne-mbappe') reuses the SAME slug across 3 distinct consecutive calendar dates (2026-08-27/28/29) — the slug alone is therefore not 1:1 with one real occurrence. The composite of the site's own slug plus this card's own (DETERMINISTIC_CONTEXT-derived) governing date is unique per real occurrence, reproduced offline in evidence/offline-proof-output.txt.

derivation.rule: Concatenate this source's own permalink slug with this card's own governing calendar date, joined by '#', to disambiguate a slug the source itself reuses across more than one real occurrence.

event_url.notes: Each card's own 'En savoir plus' link href, stated directly (resolved to an absolute URL against the site's own domain).

price.notes: No price/tarif/euro text appears anywhere on this page. Each card's own 'Réserver' button links to a third-party ticketing domain (billetweb.fr), which this project's policy does not treat as first-party authority for a price fact (docs/SOURCE_INVESTIGATION_POLICY.md's 'Third-party sources' section).

blockers.description: Only page 1 of the site's own real, server-rendered pagination (/fr/agenda, /fr/agenda/page-2 .. page-9 confirmed present as real links) was fetched within this bounded investigation, covering ~3 weeks (2026-08-27 to 2026-09-17). A production collector would iterate the same static pagination pattern for fuller date-range coverage — not fetched here to keep this investigation bounded, and not required to prove the acquisition path or field coverage.
